steps.message: In Simple Calendar Pro, create a calendar event for this Friday at 9h with the title 'Catch up on Annual Report' and the description 'We will prepare for upcoming project milestones. Looking forward to productive discussions.'. The event should last for 15 mins.
Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z %u'; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple|calendar'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z %u'; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple|calendar'""
